http_port.label: HTTP Server Port
http_port.description: Port for the MSX HTTP server.

player_idle_timeout.label: Player Idle Timeout (minutes)
player_idle_timeout.description: Show an MSX player as unavailable after this many minutes without activity, until its TV connects again.

show_stop_notification.label: Show playback stopped notification
show_stop_notification.description: Show an informational notice after MSX playback is stopped from MA.

group_stream_mode.label: Stream Delivery Mode
group_stream_mode.description: How audio reaches the TVs. 'MA Streamserver' redirects TVs directly and is recommended. 'Independent' proxies a separate local ffmpeg stream for compatibility. Redirect falls back to Independent automatically when a direct URL cannot be resolved.

manifest.description: Stream music to Smart TVs via Media Station X
